about.metaDescription: Learn more about thesolution.at - your partner for IT consulting, datacenter virtualization, cloud and AI in Austria.
about.title: About thesolution.at
about.intro: We are a specialized IT consulting company based in Vienna, Austria. Our team combines over 25 years of experience in datacenter virtualization, cloud architecture and artificial intelligence to develop tailored solutions for businesses of all sizes.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: We empower businesses to unlock the full potential of modern IT infrastructure. By combining proven enterprise expertise with cutting-edge cloud and AI technologies, we help our customers become more agile, secure, and cost-efficient.

expertise.title: Our Expertise
expertise.text: Specialized in VMware migration for the Broadcom era, AWS multicloud strategies, Kubernetes orchestration with Cilium, Databricks lakehouse architectures, and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform. Additionally, we develop production-ready AI and ML solutions.

values.title: Our Values
values.text: Transparency, data privacy, and technical excellence are at the core of our work. All our solutions are hosted in the EU, are GDPR-compliant, and follow a "Security by Design" approach. We rely on open-source technologies and avoid vendor lock-in.

location.title: Our Location
location.text: Headquartered in Vienna, Austria. We serve customers throughout the DACH region and remotely across Europe. Our hosting infrastructure runs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) with locations in the European Union.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy for thesolution.at - GDPR-compliant data processing, cookie-free and EU-hosted.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.responsibleText: Responsible within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Austrian Telecommunications Act (TKG 2021) is:
privacy.company: The Solution Virtualization Consolidation Company e.U.
privacy.hostingText: This website is hosted on a server from Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), managed via Coolify. Server locations are within the European Union (EU). All data is processed and stored exclusively in EU data centers.
privacy.cookiesText: This website does not use cookies and does not implement any tracking. No personal data is stored on your device.
privacy.cookiesImportant: This website is purely static and therefore does not require cookie consent.
privacy.cookiesStorage: Local storage (localStorage) is used exclusively to save your decision regarding the cookie notice banner.
privacy.logsText1: The hosting provider automatically collects technical information that your browser transmits when you access this website. This data is not personally identifiable to us.
privacy.logsText2: This data is not merged with other data sources and is used solely for the technical functionality and security of our website.
privacy.sslText: This website uses SSL/TLS encryption for security reasons and to protect the transmission of confidential content. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the browser's address bar switching from "http://" to "https://" and the lock icon.
privacy.fontsText: This website uses locally hosted fonts (Inter and Outfit). Fonts are loaded from our server with no connection to external servers (such as Google Fonts).
privacy.embedsText: Our website embeds Google Maps. When you visit these pages, a connection to Google servers is established, and data may be transmitted to Google.
privacy.rightsText: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
rightsList: Right of access: information about your personal data
Right to rectification: correction of inaccurate data
Right to erasure: deletion of your data
Right to restriction: restriction of processing
Right to object: objection to processing
Right to data portability: data in a structured format
Right to lodge a complaint: with the data protection authority
privacy.contactText: For data protection inquiries, you can contact us at any time:
privacy.updateText: This privacy policy was last updated on March 10, 2026.
